description: Find optional content references for one resolved movie or show when a comparison is useful. Returns ReelRecs Score out of 10, descriptions, tags, subgenres and links. Candidates are selected from content without audience-score or viewing/rating-affinity selection. They do not represent a shared group of raters, and no peer average is calculated. Missing scores are null. Streaming offers are not included.

limit.description: Reference candidates for the assistant to assess. Choose only useful comparisons; a fixed peer count is not required.

title_id.description: Resolved title to compare with content peers. Use search_titles for its exact version first.
